title: Kerala likely to see 20% drop in remittances as West Asia war drags on

title: What does law say on tenure of Prime Minister?
summary: India has developed a convention limiting a third presidential term, but the Constitution places no such restriction on the Prime Minister’s tenure. With Prime Minister Narendra Modi completing 8,931 days in office, this asymmetry invites closer scrutiny.
